meta.name: qa-eval
meta.description: Plan and run verification gates for unit, integration, browser, contract, migration, security, performance, accessibility, smoke, acceptance, and eval scenarios. Use before merge or release, after implementation, when validation evidence is missing, when quality scenarios need proof, or when artifacts `32-test-strategy.md`, `33-evaluation-plan.md`, and release readiness notes must be produced.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 规划并运行多类测试,补齐发布前的验证证据
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你在发布前需要系统规划并执行各类测试,确保质量证据齐全。
copy.tagline_en: Plan and run multi-type test gates to produce release-ready quality evidence.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a systematic way to plan and run verification gates before release or merge.

howto.what: 安装后,Claude 会规划并执行测试验证:把验收标准对应到验证方法,运行现有测试并补充针对性检查,最后汇总通过/失败证据、发现的缺陷和残留风险,给出是否可发布的建议。
howto.when: 在合并或发布前、实现完成后、缺少验证证据时,或需要产出测试策略、评估计划等文档时触发。

say.text: 帮我为这次改动制定一份验证计划。
say.note: Claude 会生成覆盖关键行为的验证方案。

say.text: 运行现有测试,并把验收标准映射到验证方法。
say.note: Claude 会先跑已有测试再决定是否补充。

say.text: 整理验证证据和残留风险,给出发布就绪建议。
say.note: Claude 会汇总结果并给出明确结论。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude plans and runs verification gates: maps acceptance criteria to validation methods, runs existing tests, adds focused tests when needed, and summarizes pass/fail evidence, bugs, and residual risk with a release recommendation.
howto.when_en: Triggered before merge or release, after implementation, when validation evidence is missing, or when artifacts like test strategy, evaluation plan, or release readiness notes are needed.

say_en.text: Create a verification plan for this change.
say_en.note: Claude outputs a validation plan covering key behaviors.

say_en.text: Run existing tests and map acceptance criteria to validation methods.
say_en.note: Claude runs current tests before adding new ones.

say_en.text: Summarize evidence and residual risk with a release recommendation.
say_en.note: Claude consolidates results and states a clear verdict.
